local m = {}

function m._get_entity_name(frame, args, entity, key)
	if not entity then
		return key
	elseif entity.page then
		return entity.page
	elseif entity.name then
		return entity.name
	else
		return key
	end
end

function m._get_entity_page(frame, args, entity, key)
	if not entity then
		return key
	elseif entity.name then
		return entity.name
	elseif entity.page then
		return entity.page
	else
		return key
	end
end

return m
